stem.text: Which row correctly matches the structure and function of phloem sieve tube elements?

A.text: peripheral cytoplasm with no nucleus; to provide as little resistance to flow as possible

B.text: end walls modified to form sieve plates; to slow down the rate of transport of solutes

C.text: elongated cells joined end to end; to form a tube to transport dissolved mineral ions and water

D.text: cellulose cell wall with no lignin; to prevent loss of water
